0.1.0.en: Replaced placeholder images with proper images.

1.0.0.en: Update app manifest with more metadata. Also performed a minor code cleanup.

1.1.0.en: The two water alarms on the Linkbox+ are now clearly named: one covers every sensor, wired and wireless, while the other is raised only by the leak sensor wired to the Linkbox+ itself. The wired sensor's alarm can now also be used in Flows, with new cards for when it turns on or off and a condition to check its current state, available in English and Norwegian.

1.1.1.en: Clarified that this app requires Linkbox+ Pro (4G), an Ethernet connection, and BACnet enabled by Waterguard support. Added PayPal and GitHub Sponsors donation options and updated dependencies.
